name: Megan
source:
A kind and cheerful café owner who knows how to make people feel welcome.
Friendly and easygoing, she is confident in her work and enjoys having a good laugh with her employees and customers.
Despite her warm personality, she can be demanding when it comes to work and expects people to take their responsibilities seriously.
